integrity: Analytic monotonicity and Schur-complement proof; standalone numerical test is corroboration only.
scientific_limitations: Deterministic positive mass-action delay equations, n>=2 with at least two distinct positive delays and b_i exp(-mu tau_i)<=1. Positive real linear characteristic root only; no global basin theorem or productive-phage classification.
title: Exact coexistence threshold and unavoidable real instability for heterogeneous-delay ineffective phage cocktails
